notes.title: Omega Boss Released!
notes.notes: [p]The Omega Boss has been publicly released! It is currently playable in the demo build. This is the first major boss encounter in Blobbert and Tutorialbert, with the simbot encounter previously in the demo being a tutorial on how to fight bosses. Omega will battle with rockets, call in backup from the Schloopies (a new enemy appearing exclusively in this bossfight) and so much more![/p][p]Play this bossfight now! It appears at the end of liquid laboratory with a new cutscene that changes with your playable character. It's a real great time! Have fun![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596312/1a728f2f582e95a3b54fae3357ec4bc9e58e4d78.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Playtest Requests now Open!
notes.notes:
I have decided to test out the Omega boss on a decently large scale before I continue working on the next update for the demo (which will contain the omega boss). About 40-60 people who apply will be given access to the build, and access will be revoked 4-7 days after its release. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596312/1a728f2f582e95a3b54fae3357ec4bc9e58e4d78.png[/img]

If you receive this testing build, you agree that you may release video clips of the build, but may not distribute it, or de-compile it for the purposes of removing anti-distribution measures. This activity will have you prohibited from all future playtesting opportunities. I thank you for your compliance in advance.[img]
